# Codebook

Synthetic codebook for the checker fixtures only. It uses the same format as `translator/reference/codebook.md`; the entries are made up to exercise the codebook rules and are not part of the translator.

Rules for entries:

- Printed text is copied exactly from a receipt: same characters, same case, one space between words.
- Each printed text appears once. Ids are never reused or renumbered.
- Category is one of the categories below, spelled exactly.

## Categories

| Category |
|---|
| Produce |
| Dairy & Eggs |
| Meat & Seafood |
| Bakery |
| Pantry |
| Frozen |
| Snacks |
| Beverages |
| Household |
| Personal Care |
